findings: ProgramSlots, ProgramCarrier, PreparedProgramFamily and ProgramIo retain original cold program/IO/physical slot facts. Ordinary and relay use the same prepare_evaluations entry.

Ordinary, K1 and recursive K>1 share finish_selected_evaluations and ExecutionEpisode::finish_success. Private draft uses that same resource handoff. Original completion, output detachment, Append/Store return and input withdrawal remain authoritative.
ContinuationCohort and advance_request_wave share ordered request/credit/retirement policy. CompletedEvaluationView exposes borrowed output facts to independently compiled reporting.

Actual model packing, token/hidden mapping, complete state layout, Source dependency facts, mathematical role legality and Head publication remain model-specific. No second executor or generic callback forwarding shell is required.
The confirmed actual-bank cold assembly gap is fixed by this batch. No additional clearly duplicated common execution algorithm was identified in the finite review.
Architecture document opening statements that all full handoff/common output mechanisms remain unimplemented were stale and are corrected.
limits: There is still only one complete real engine model; other families are actual component consumers with separately documented fixture and hardware limits.
Stable public engine C++ API, generic loader/tokenizer/server and multi-GPU/multi-machine implementation remain undelivered or outside this batch.
